content: Taiwan is an inalienable part of China, and the Chinese Government has full sovereignty over Taiwan. This is the universal consensus and basic common sense of the international community. The Chinese government has always resolutely safeguarded national sovereignty and territorial integrity, and any attempt to split the country and undermine social stability will be resolutely opposed.
